text:
Samira (People Ops): dropping a compact 'goal + feedback' micro-kit that ties to benefits/hiring signals and performance cycle dates. want quick reviews before i publish.

Dev (Eng Manager): looks useful. can you call out how this maps to promotion criteria? managers always ask.

Samira (People Ops): added a small 'career impact' checkbox (None / Development / Promotion-readiness) and a one-line rationale so managers can be explicit.

Rox (IC): can we include a clear OOO/backup field so goals survive planned leave? last cycle we had gaps.

Samira (People Ops): yep  'Planned OOO & Backup' is on the card. also an auto-fill hint: if owner's OOO overlaps delivery window, add a backup or reduce scope.

Luca (Recruiting): great. add a 'Hiring signal' field (Y/N + why) so Recruiting sees when hires are tied to goal delivery. helps prioritization.

Samira (People Ops): added it. sample use: "Hiring signal: Y Need senior infra by 2026-06-15 to hit SLO rollouts".

Dev (Eng Manager): how about measurable success criteria for exploratory work? sometimes we can't give a hard metric.

Samira (People Ops): three accepted patterns included: deliverable shipped (artifact + acceptance test), learning milestone (experiment + writeup), decision gate (go/no-go with criteria). examples pasted.

Rox (IC): tidy. could add peer-review prompts that take <60s to answer. otherwise folks won't fill them.

Samira (People Ops): micro-peer prompts added: 1) One-line observed outcome; 2) One suggestion to amplify impact; 3) One small offer to help next quarter. Optional: 'One thing to stop' for calibration.

Dev (Eng Manager): manager acceptance checklist? we need a 3-item quick-check to approve goals during handoff.

Samira (People Ops): done: 
- Outcome-oriented & primary metric or milestone defined (Y/N)
- Owners & backups clear (Y/N)
- Dependencies/hiring flagged (Y/N)
Managers tick and archive.

PolicyBot: FYI performance calibration window opens 2026-07-10 and closes 2026-07-24. Goals accepted after close will be considered for next cycle.

Luca (Recruiting): heads up  if Hiring signal = Y please add 'role type' and 'need-by' date so we can triage requisitions.

Samira (People Ops): added 'Role type' and 'Need-by' fields to the sample card and to the TL;DR paste block for calendar invites.

Rox (IC): also include a one-sentence 'why this matters' for each goal. helps with cross-team alignment during demos.

Samira (People Ops): added the 'why' line. final sample card in-thread: 

Goal: Reduce inference p95 tail latency
Why: improve user-perceived responsiveness and reduce error retries
Primary success metric: p95 <= 120ms on release traffic for 7 consecutive days
Owners: Rox (primary) / Dev (backup)
Est weekly focus: 20%
Planned OOO & Backup: Rox OOO Jul 12-16; Dev covers canary
Hiring signal: Y Role: Senior Infra Eng Need-by: 2026-06-15
Career impact: Development (improves cross-team leadership)
Dependencies: autoscaler rollout, quantization experiment

Samira (People Ops): note on policy: if a goal ties to compensation or promotion, please mark it and attach supporting evidence in the self-review doc. PolicyBot will flag entries missing evidence.

PolicyBot: Reminder: Promotion-evidence checklist available at /policies/promo-evidence. Missing evidence may delay calibration.

Dev (Eng Manager): this is good. please drop PDF + markdown + TL;DR into #docs and ping managers. i'll pilot with my ICs tomorrow.

Samira (People Ops): will do  uploading now and adding to the self-review hub. thanks for the quick feedback!
